commands.name: progress-inventory
argv:
import json,pathlib,re
p=pathlib.Path('plans/multi-raft');task=next(t for t in json.loads((p/'tasks.json').read_text())['tasks'] if t['id']=='MR-11')
listing=(p/'evidence/MR-11-leadership-membership-list.log').read_text()
listed={m.group(1) for line in listing.splitlines() if (m:=re.fullmatch(r'(\S+): test',line))}
required={case['name'] for case in task['test_cases']};missing=required-listed
assert len(listed)==16,(len(listed),listed)
assert missing=={'automatic_no_traffic_repair','leader_balance_with_lag'},missing
assert {'joint_plan_process_kill_resume','native_leadership_transfer_checks_progress'} <= listed
print(json.dumps({'partial_inventory':'passed','listed':len(listed),'required_present':len(required & listed),'required_total':len(required),'remaining':sorted(missing),'full_inventory_qualified':False}))
